Change c0388. Location: 1818 Vol. III, Ch. III; 1831 Ch. XX.

Context before (unchanged): I constructed another sail with a part of my dress, and eagerly steered my course towards the land.

1818 text: It had a wild and rocky appearance; but as I approached nearer, I easily perceived the traces of cultivation. I saw vessels near the shore, and found myself suddenly transported back to the neighbourhood of civilized man. I eagerly traced the windings of the land, and hailed a steeple which I at length saw issuing from behind a small promontory. As I was in a state of extreme debility, I resolved to sail directly towards the town as a place where I could most easily procure nourishment.

1831 text: It had a wild and rocky appearance; but, as I approached nearer, I easily perceived the traces of cultivation. I saw vessels near the shore, and found myself suddenly transported back to the neighbourhood of civilised man. I carefully traced the windings of the land, and hailed a steeple which I at length saw issuing from behind a small promontory. As I was in a state of extreme debility, I resolved to sail directly towards the town, as a place where I could most easily procure nourishment.

Diff: It had a wild and rocky appearance; but {+,+} as I approached nearer, I easily perceived the traces of cultivation. I saw vessels near the shore, and found myself suddenly transported back to the neighbourhood of [-civilized-] {+civilised+} man. I [-eagerly-] {+carefully+} traced the windings of the land, and hailed a steeple which I at length saw issuing from behind a small promontory. As I was in a state of extreme debility, I resolved to sail directly towards the town {+,+} as a place where I could most easily procure nourishment.

Context after (unchanged): Fortunately I had money with me.

result.rationale: Mainly a word swap: 'eagerly' becomes 'carefully' before 'traced the windings of the land', shifting the Creature's manner from urgency to deliberate care. Also 'civilized' to 'civilised' and punctuation changes, which are orthographic.
